title: Whole-tissue immunolabeling and lightsheet imaging of c-Fos in mouse brains
author: Fu, Yang
materials: Donkey anti-rabbit IgG, Alexa Fluor Plus 647

steps.title: Observe preparation timings
steps.instruction: Allocate ~1 h for steps 1‑2, ~1 h for steps 3‑4, ~30 min for steps 5‑6, ~90 min for steps 7‑11, 10 min for step 12, 20 min for step 13, 10 min for step 14, and 15 min, 10 min, 10 min for steps 15, 16, 17 respectively.

steps.title: Make 4% formaldehyde solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve 40 g paraformaldehyde powder in 950 mL ddH₂O pre‑heated to 60 °C, add 5 M NaOH dropwise with gentle stirring until fully dissolved, then bring the volume to 1 000 mL with ddH₂O; adjust pH to 7.4 if needed, store at 4 °C (up to 1 week).

substeps.instruction: Add 40 g paraformaldehyde to 950 mL ddH₂O at 60 °C.
Add 5 M NaOH dropwise while stirring until dissolved.
Adjust final volume to 1 000 mL with ddH₂O and set pH to 7.4.

steps.title: Make 10 mg/mL heparin stock
steps.instruction: Dissolve 1 g heparin sodium powder in 100 mL ddH₂O, rotate until fully dissolved, then filter through a 0.22‑µm syringe filter; store at 4 °C (up to 1 week).

substeps.instruction: Add 1 g heparin sodium to 100 mL ddH₂O.
Rotate until completely dissolved.
Filter through a 0.22‑µm syringe filter.

steps.title: Prepare Perfusion Buffers A and B
steps.instruction: Prepare fresh Perfusion Buffer A and Perfusion Buffer B according to the Materials table, pre‑warm both to 37 °C before tissue harvesting, and handle in a chemical hood.

steps.title: Prepare Fixation Buffer
steps.instruction: Prepare fresh Fixation Buffer as described in the Materials table on the day of use and handle in a chemical hood.

steps.title: Prepare methanol series (20‑80%)
steps.instruction: Make 20 %, 40 %, 60 % and 80 % (v/v) methanol solutions in ddH₂O; store at 22‑25 °C; use glass containers with polypropylene caps and styrene‑butadiene rubber liners; handle methanol in a hood.

steps.title: Prepare Decolorization Solution
steps.instruction: Prepare Decolorization Solution as detailed in the Materials table, make 1 day in advance, precool to 4 °C before use, and handle methanol and H₂O₂ in a chemical hood.

steps.title: Make 0.5 M EDTA‑Na stock
steps.instruction: Dissolve 73 g EDTA in 480 mL ddH₂O, add 5 M NaOH dropwise with gentle stirring until fully dissolved, then bring volume to 500 mL with ddH₂O; adjust pH to 8.0 if needed, store at 4 °C (up to 1 week).

substeps.instruction: Add 73 g EDTA to 480 mL ddH₂O.
Add 5 M NaOH dropwise while stirring until dissolved.
Adjust final volume to 500 mL with ddH₂O and set pH to 8.0.

steps.title: Make 10 % Triton X‑100 stock
steps.instruction: Dissolve 5 g Triton X‑100 in 40 mL ddH₂O, stir continuously until visually homogeneous, then bring volume to 50 mL with ddH₂O; store at 4 °C (up to 1 week).

substeps.instruction: Add 5 g Triton X‑100 to 40 mL ddH₂O.
Stir continuously until homogeneous.
Adjust final volume to 50 mL with ddH₂O.

steps.title: Make 5 % deoxycholate stock
steps.instruction: Dissolve 5 g deoxycholate powder in 90 mL ddH₂O, then bring volume to 100 mL with ddH₂O; store at 4 °C (up to 1 week).

substeps.instruction: Add 5 g deoxycholate to 90 mL ddH₂O.
Adjust final volume to 100 mL with ddH₂O.

steps.title: Make 10 % Tween 20 stock
steps.instruction: Dissolve 10 g Tween 20 in 85 mL ddH₂O, stir continuously until visually homogeneous, then bring volume to 100 mL with ddH₂O; store at 4 °C (up to 1 week).

substeps.instruction: Add 10 g Tween 20 to 85 mL ddH₂O.
Stir continuously until homogeneous.
Adjust final volume to 100 mL with ddH₂O.

steps.title: Make 10 % sodium azide stock
steps.instruction: Dissolve 1 g sodium azide in 8 mL ddH₂O, then bring volume to 10 mL with ddH₂O; store at 4 °C (up to 1 week).

substeps.instruction: Add 1 g sodium azide to 8 mL ddH₂O.
Adjust final volume to 10 mL with ddH₂O.

steps.title: Prepare Permeabilization Buffer
steps.instruction: Prepare Permeabilization Buffer as described in the Materials table, filter through a 0.22‑µm syringe filter, store at 22‑25 °C (up to 1 week).

steps.title: Prepare Immunolabeling Buffer
steps.instruction: Prepare Immunolabeling Buffer as described in the Materials table, filter through a 0.22‑µm syringe filter after diluting primary or secondary antibody, store at 4 °C (up to 1 day).

steps.title: Prepare Washing Buffer
steps.instruction: Prepare Washing Buffer as described in the Materials table, filter through a 0.22‑µm syringe filter, store at 22‑25 °C (up to 1 week).

steps.title: Make 0.8 % agarose in PBS
steps.instruction: Add 0.8 g agarose powder to 100 mL 1× PBS, heat in a microwave until fully dissolved, let cool to ~50 °C before embedding tissue; prepare fresh.

substeps.instruction: Add 0.8 g agarose to 100 mL 1× PBS.
Microwave until agarose dissolves.
Cool mixture to approximately 50 °C.

steps.title: Mix dichloromethane and methanol (2:1)
steps.instruction: Prepare a 2 : 1 (v/v) mixture of dichloromethane and methanol on the day of use; handle both solvents in a chemical hood, use glass bottles with polypropylene caps and styrene‑butadiene rubber liners.

steps.title: Fill imaging chamber with dibenzyl ether
steps.instruction: Fill the imaging chamber with 100 % dibenzyl‑ether on the day of use; handle dibenzyl‑ether in a chemical hood and use appropriate glass containers.
